first_divergence_timing.observed_temporal_sequence: SOC/Battery Action -> Diesel Commitment -> Renewable Curtailment

objective_contribution_analysis.primary_objective_mechanism: Late-horizon objective discounting (gamma=0.95) suppresses premature diesel commitment induced by mid/late horizon solar forecast over-predictions.

control_context.interpretation: Class F gamma=0.95 does not merely reverse V2 degradation; it mitigates optimizer over-reaction to late-horizon solar forecast error, achieving lower fuel consumption than both V2 Treatment and Control.

mechanism_classifications.claim: V3 Class F reduces mean diesel fuel by 13.28 L/origin relative to V2 Treatment.
V3 Class F reduces diesel runtime by 0.97 h/origin and startups by 0.27/origin.
V3 Class F reduces renewable curtailment from 56.95 kWh to 17.57 kWh/origin.
Exponential discount factor gamma=0.95 reduces sensitivity to mid/late horizon forecast over-predictions.
The primary operational driver of fuel reduction is the delay or elimination of unnecessary pre-emptive diesel commitments.
Class F will achieve identical numerical fuel reductions on the physical Nuolja station.

candidate_v4_classes.name: Asymmetric / Objective-Term-Specific Horizon Discounting
candidate_v4_classes.targeted_mechanism: Apply distinct discount factors gamma_diesel vs gamma_curtail to decouple immediate fuel costs from distant curtailment penalties.
candidate_v4_classes.supporting_evidence: Observed V3 mechanism demonstrates that discounting late-horizon curtailment penalties prevents premature diesel commitment.

candidate_v4_classes.name: Forecast-Variance-Adaptive SOC Reserve Bounds
candidate_v4_classes.targeted_mechanism: Dynamically adjust minimum SOC reserve bounds E_min(t) based on rolling forecast variance f_var(y_pred).
candidate_v4_classes.supporting_evidence: V3 SOC trajectory shows that maintaining higher early SOC prevents late-horizon diesel dispatch when solar underperforms.

candidate_v4_classes.name: Minimum-Runtime Diesel Commitment Hysteresis
candidate_v4_classes.targeted_mechanism: Combine Class F horizon weighting with explicit minimum runtime constraints T_min,on.
candidate_v4_classes.supporting_evidence: V3 reduced startup events from 1.03 to 0.76; explicit hysteresis could eliminate remaining short diesel cycles.

real_world_boundary_statement: All replays were conducted within the synthetic POLARIS digital twin environment. No claim of real Nuolja station fuel savings or physical station operational robustness is made.
v4_implementation_status: NO V4 IMPLEMENTATION OR EXECUTION OCCURRED.
